title: Highmoor Rising Again
premise: Edmund Reyes fled his hedge-witch master with nothing but a stolen grimoire and a talent for numbers, finding safety in the Guild of Impossible Things, where he keeps ledgers of traded memories, borrowed luck, and second chances. When the border wards collapse and the stars go dark, Edmund discovers the guild's ledgers record a debt owed by King Aldric — a debt the thing wearing his crown has come to collect in blood. Guided by Serah, a ward-keeper he once loved and abandoned, Edmund must unbind the true king from the usurper's bargain before the armies of the Hollow Crown reach the free cities. He succeeds at the cost of his own name in the ledgers, erasing himself from memory to pay the debt — though Serah, who kept a page of him hidden, remembers enough to find him again.
about_author: Lena Halloran is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing obscure trade ledgers before turning to fantasy, a background that infuses her fiction with meticulous, bureaucratic magic. She lives in a coastal town where she writes stories about ordinary people caught in the gears of enormous debts.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Edmund, reconciling the guild's impossible ledgers, notices entries rewriting themselves as the stars vanish and the border wards fall. His master's stolen grimoire begins bleeding ink. When guild assassins arrive to reclaim the grimoire, Edmund flees with a ledger page bearing King Aldric's name. POV: Edmund. Emotional beat: terror sharpened into resolve — the runaway finally runs toward something.

chapters.title: The Debt of Crowns
chapters.summary: Edmund seeks Serah, now the last ward-keeper at a crumbling border shrine, and learns the wards fell because the Hollow Crown called in the guild's oldest debt: a king's soul, pawned generations ago. Serah's fury at his abandonment mirrors his shame, but the ledgers show the debt can be transferred — to the debtor's kin, or the one who holds the page. POV: alternating Edmund and Serah. Emotional beat: old love rekindled through resentment.

chapters.title: What Wears the Crown
chapters.summary: Infiltrating the besieged capital as guild auditors, Edmund and Serah reach Aldric, imprisoned inside his own body by the thing that took his name. Edmund attempts the transfer ritual, but the Hollow Crown reveals the trap: the guild itself brokered the original bargain, and completing it brands Edmund as the new debtor. Serah is captured holding the line. POV: Edmund. Emotional beat: the climax — duty to justice versus the price of survival, and he chooses both, badly.

chapters.title: A Page Hidden Away
chapters.summary: Edmund pays the debt by writing himself out of existence — every ledger, every memory — unbinding Aldric and breaking the Hollow Crown as the usurper's armies falter without their master's bargain. The free cities hold. But Serah, who secretly copied a single page of Edmund before the ritual, searches the ledgers until she finds a man who doesn't remember her, and begins reading him back. POV: Serah, closing on Edmund. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into patient, stubborn hope.
